plan.title: eRFX RFQ invite mapped and named vendor

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and keep Publish usable.
Configure the project with an RFQ-only stage.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add the requested product and quantity to the RFQ.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet so the item configuration is complete.
Set the requested delivery location for the line item.
Verify the requested delivery location was retained.
Add every vendor mapped to the product using the product-based invitation control.
Add the explicitly named Vendor C from the vendor search.
Verify publishing reached a real project page.
Open the published RFQ stage's Participants list.
Verify Vendor C is listed as a selected participant after publishing.
Verify the published stage has participants rather than an empty audience.
